title: Chapter whereby the Merta goddesses are kept back

verses.t: Chapter whereby the Merta goddesses are kept back.
Hail ye Pair of goddesses Merta, Sister Pair, Merta! I inform you of my Words of Power.
It is I who rise up from the Sektit boat. I am Horus the son of Isis, and I am come to see my father, Osiris.
